get.description: Standalone HR command. Current identity, membership, installation, entitlement and role are checked before the isolated effect. Attendance captures an interval, not proof of work; leave uses calendar days and makes no statutory or payroll claim.

202.description: Durable command accepted; poll its private result receipt

403.description: Current membership, role or entitlement denied

404.description: HR record unavailable in this organization or to this employee

409.description: Version, overlap, allowance, or state conflict

x-completed-result.description: Scoped HR record or bounded data/meta page with server status options.
